tips.text: Join an established clan that already has the Venka research finished instead of building a dojo just for it.
Start each 3-day research as soon as the last finishes, and gather the next item's materials while one runs.
If the blueprint purchase errors, check that you are in that clan and the Venka research shows as complete.
Budget one Forma on top of the 4 Gallium, 1,000 Salvage and 500 Plastids.
Players call Venka easy once the dojo exists; the only real wait is the three research timers.
